notes: ccEmails and currencyId are silently ignored on create (ccEmails returns null; currency falls back to workspace default); PUT persists both.
currencyCode is inert on both verbs; only currencyId (PUT only) sets the currency.
A previously deleted entity name stays reserved; re-create may report 'already exists' — retry with a distinct name.
Client must be archived before DELETE (archive is a replace-PUT carrying at least name + archived:true).
DELETE answers 200 with the full deleted entity.
Last-Page response header is authoritative for pagination.
Omitting archived returns archived AND active rows; only archived=false restricts to active.
Replacing PUT with proven replacement risk: omitting ccEmails clears stored addresses; resend name and ccEmails on every update.
currencyCode is inert; currencyId works only on PUT.
Clockify accepts client archive updates only with the nested body shape {name, archived:true}; top-level fields return 'Required request body is missing'.
